title: KATSEYE, Megan Thee Stallion, Tate McRae & Megan Moroney to Perform at 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show
summary: The all-women lineup will hit the runway on Oct. 18 in Los Angeles.
contentText:
The Victoria’s Secret Angels will share the runway with some pretty big names across country, pop and hip-hop: KATSEYE , Megan Moroney , Megan Thee Stallion and Tate McRae are all set to perform at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show next month, Billboard can exclusively reveal.

The all-women lineup will perform at the fashion show on Oct. 18 in Los Angeles.

The performance announcement comes amid world tours for both KATSEYE and Megan Moroney. KATSEYE kicked off their WILDWORLD Tour earlier this month in support of their brand-new WILD EP, which gave the group their first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 . Moroney also scored her first No. 1 on the albums chart in March with Cloud 9 , and is currently on her Cloud 9 Tour.

Last month, Megan Thee Stallion signed a distribution deal between Interscope and her Hot Girl Productions company, letting her fans know: “ACT III IS ON THEE WAY HOTTIES.” Also in August, McRae put on a buzzy headlining set at Lollapalooza and teased her next era on Instagram .

The Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show has long been known for its blockbuster music performances, including Taylor Swift in 2013 and 2014, Rihanna in 2012 and 2015, Lady Gaga in 2016 and another epic all-women lineup last year of Karol G, TWICE, Missy Elliott and Madison Beer.

This year’s show will take place in Los Angeles at a yet-announced venue, where it will stream live globally on Sunday, Oct. 18. Viewers can tune in through YouTube at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT, while Victoria’s Secret will also stream the event across its Instagram and TikTok accounts.
